goal: Compare every factual claim in the doc under review against the source excerpts in the other context files. A claim has drifted when the doc states a behavior, default, path, or name that a source excerpt contradicts. Report each drifted claim as one string: the doc's claim verbatim, then ' -> ', then what the source actually says. Count every claim you checked, drifted or not. Verdict is 'clean' when nothing drifted, 'drift-found' otherwise. Do not report a drift you cannot ground in a specific source line.
